SELECT 'cal' AS k, fiscal_year AS a, CAST(fiscal_period AS VARCHAR) AS b, CAST(period_start_date AS VARCHAR) AS c, CAST(period_end_date AS VARCHAR) AS d, CAST(fully_loaded AS VARCHAR) AS e, '' AS f FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=5
UNION ALL

calls.statement:
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units, COUNT(*) AS line_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT 'fact' AS src, SUM(f.quantity) AS units, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dn, MIN(f.sale_date) AS mn, MAX(f.sale_date) AS mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'rpt', SUM(units_sold), COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT business_date), MIN(business_date), MAX(business_date) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
